description: Fork of exp084 with two changes: (a) residual_lut input uses INVERSE concat order torch.cat([*prev_xs, x], dim=-1) — token_emb at front, current x at tail. With this ordering layer i's first i*E slots correspond exactly to layer (i-1)'s entire residual_lut input, so layer (i-1)'s anchor-pair indices remain valid in layer i's input space. (b) Post-construction, the first 256*i anchor pairs (a/b) of layer i's residual_lut.lookup are overwritten with a copy of layer (i-1)'s 256*i anchor pairs. Each layer adds 256 fresh anchor pairs sampled over the full (i+1)*E input. Tables and weights remain independent; only the anchoring (which input slots a table reads) is inherited. Same param budget as exp084.
